BASE:1149:1149.text: Each matrix entry is statically classified as INPUT_CURRENT, TARGET_RESERVED, or IMMUTABLE_REFERENCE by STAGE_OPERATION_SCOPE_MATRIX. Creation operations use application-reserved target identities for the version or record they create; they do not pretend that the target already exists. Read dependencies use current input identities. The response echoes both classes in their registered locations, and the application verifies every input current and every target still reserved.

BASE:1151:1151.text: A dimension designated by this matrix is required and non-null. A scope dimension not designated for the operation is prohibited unless the registry marks it as an immutable referenced target. Missing, extra, stale, unreserved, or inconsistent dimensions are rejected before proposal creation or command execution.

A pair is available only for a current accepted definition and its current accepted, independently reviewed execution-test binding, with established definition/test/fixture/target/outcome compatibility, the declared earliest executable stage reached, and the required current target-availability and phase conditions TRUE. Unknown, stale or unavailable prerequisites block; a legitimately future definition remains visible and unexecuted. Timing, compatibility and authority cannot be supplied by this list or inferred from a route label.

The routes remain receipt-only: one appended regressionExecutions receipt for the selected subject and ordinary supporting evidence, through the existing reserved external response path or existing isolated application-native execution path as its reviewed execution mode requires. They cannot rewrite definitions, complete unrelated ordinary stage work, expose future-stage material early, or mutate canonical user data as a test fixture. Owning Stage07/Stage15 writers and Stage17 REGRESSION permissions are unchanged. No new operation name, executor, store or canonical family is introduced.

Each execution retains exact subject/test/fixture/target identities and hashes, selected stage and operation, current scope and history activation, actual isolation and attributable raw/native provenance. Failure validation requires an actual observation establishing rejection of the bound known-invalid fixture. Regression pre-correction failure and post-correction success require distinct executions and distinct actual target input identities; one observation cannot prove both. Existing capability, risk/disclosure authorization, human review where required, compatibility, reservation, retry, replacement, receipt, freshness and restoration controls remain mandatory and cannot be bypassed by an input-basis minimum. Supported semantic compatibility and application-observed input custody remain separate facts; a supported author interpretation does not change a valid native executor into an external one.

This is the explicit current-source inclusion of exactly the 38 previously adopted conditional pairs. It preserves their bounded authority; it does not adopt every omitted historical clause, widen their writer permissions, migrate old evidence into current proof, or certify that any implementation or execution conforms.
